D5/S3/FluidDynamics/Vortices/Alternating.name: D5.S3.FluidDynamics.Vortices.AlternatingPolygonParameters.CollisionFree
D5/S3/FluidDynamics/Vortices/Alternating.signature: def CollisionFree {N : ℕ} (z : Configuration N) : Prop

D5/S3/FluidDynamics/Vortices/Alternating.name: D5.S3.FluidDynamics.Vortices.AlternatingPolygonParameters.angular_readout
D5/S3/FluidDynamics/Vortices/Alternating.signature: theorem angular_readout {N : ℕ} (b Ω ρ : ℝ) {z : Configuration N} (hz : CollisionFree z) (hn : ∀ j : Fin N, z (.inl j) ^ 2 + z (.inr j) ^ 2 = ρ ^ 2) (j : Fin N) : z (.inl j) * field N b Ω z (.inr j) - z (.inr j) * field N b Ω z (.inl j) = charge N j * Ω * ρ ^ 2 + (b / 4) * ((∑ k : Fin N, charge N k) - charge N j)

D5/S3/FluidDynamics/Vortices/Alternating.name: D5.S3.FluidDynamics.Vortices.AlternatingPolygonParameters.field
D5/S3/FluidDynamics/Vortices/Alternating.signature: def field (N : ℕ) (b Ω : ℝ) (z : Configuration N) : Configuration N

D5/S3/FluidDynamics/Vortices/Alternating.name: D5.S3.FluidDynamics.Vortices.AlternatingPolygonParameters.field_differentiable_at
D5/S3/FluidDynamics/Vortices/Alternating.signature: theorem field_differentiable_at {N : ℕ} (b Ω : ℝ) {z : Configuration N} (hz : CollisionFree z) : DifferentiableAt ℝ (field N b Ω) z

D5/S3/FluidDynamics/Vortices/Alternating.name: D5.S3.FluidDynamics.Vortices.AlternatingPolygonParameters.field_scaling
D5/S3/FluidDynamics/Vortices/Alternating.signature: theorem field_scaling (N : ℕ) {b Ω R : ℝ} (hR : R ≠ 0) (hb : b = 4 * Ω * R ^ 2) (w : Configuration N) (_hw : CollisionFree w) : field N b Ω (R • w) = (2 * Ω * R) • AlternatingPolygonSpectrum.field N w

D5/S3/FluidDynamics/Vortices/Alternating.name: D5.S3.FluidDynamics.Vortices.AlternatingPolygonParameters.jacobian_scaling
D5/S3/FluidDynamics/Vortices/Alternating.signature: theorem jacobian_scaling (N : ℕ) {b Ω R : ℝ} (hR : R ≠ 0) (hb : b = 4 * Ω * R ^ 2) : jacobian N b Ω (R • polygon N) = (2 * Ω) • AlternatingPolygonSpectrum.jacobian N

D5/S3/FluidDynamics/Vortices/Alternating.name: D5.S3.FluidDynamics.Vortices.AlternatingPolygonParameters.normalized_field
D5/S3/FluidDynamics/Vortices/Alternating.signature: theorem normalized_field (N : ℕ) : field N 2 (1 / 2) = AlternatingPolygonSpectrum.field N

D5/S3/FluidDynamics/Vortices/Alternating.name: D5.S3.FluidDynamics.Vortices.AlternatingPolygonParameters.regular
D5/S3/FluidDynamics/Vortices/Alternating.signature: def regular (N : ℕ) (ρ θ : ℝ) : Configuration N

D5/S3/FluidDynamics/Vortices/Alternating.name: D5.S3.FluidDynamics.Vortices.AlternatingPolygonParameters.regular_equilibrium_iff_radius
D5/S3/FluidDynamics/Vortices/Alternating.signature: theorem regular_equilibrium_iff_radius {N : ℕ} (hN : 3 ≤ N) {b Ω ρ : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b) (hΩ : 0 < Ω) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (θ : ℝ) : field N b Ω (regular N ρ θ) = 0 ↔ Even N ∧ ρ = radius b Ω

D5/S3/FluidDynamics/Vortices/Alternating.name: D5.S3.FluidDynamics.Vortices.AlternatingPolygonParameters.rotate
D5/S3/FluidDynamics/Vortices/Alternating.signature: def rotate {N : ℕ} (θ : ℝ) (z : Configuration N) : Configuration N

D5/S3/FluidDynamics/Vortices/Alternating.name: D5.S3.FluidDynamics.Vortices.AlternatingPolygonParameters.scaled_equilibrium
D5/S3/FluidDynamics/Vortices/Alternating.signature: theorem scaled_equilibrium (m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) {b Ω : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b) (hΩ : 0 < Ω) : CollisionFree ((radius b Ω) • polygon (2 * m)) ∧ field (2 * m) b Ω ((radius b Ω) • polygon (2 * m)) = 0
